entries.summary: Scheduler retries respect `selected-node` on Pending PVCs, preventing placement on another node and duplicate capacity checks during provisioning.
Migration image defaults `v1.0.4-01` → `v1.2.0`, incorporating JuiceFS fixes for directory-symlink SFTP errors and migration success incorrectly reported after listing failures.
upgradeNotes: **Operator-managed migrations:** upgrade to an [Operator containing #393](https://github.com/hwameistor/hwameistor-operator/pull/393) alongside Local Storage; set `spec.localStorage.member.juicesyncImage.tag=v1.2.0` when adopting the bundled image.
**Direct Helm image overrides:** to adopt the bundled image, set `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.tag=v1.2.0` alongside updated Local Storage.
**Existing migration Jobs:** updated settings apply only to new Jobs; existing Jobs and their retry Pods retain the original image, version and check settings.

entries.summary: Added `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version` to select bundled JuiceFS `1.2.0` (default) or `1.4.1` for migration Jobs.
upgradeNotes: **Special-file migrations:** JuiceFS `1.4.1` skips FIFOs, sockets and device nodes (including whiteouts) even with checks; `1.2.0` fails in tested cases. Neither preserves these objects.

entries.summary: Migration checks default `false` → `true` via `localStorage.migrate.check`; when enabled, `--check-all` replaces `--check-new`, comparing copied and existing files.
upgradeNotes: **Checks intentionally disabled:** set `localStorage.migrate.check=false` explicitly to retain that behavior after upgrading.

excluded.reason: Records historical v1.1.1 release notes; the described product changes predate this release range.
Maintainer-only release automation, publication workflows and editorial configuration; no installed-product behavior changes.
